# Delhi pack audit (generated by `node tools/audit_city.mjs --write`)

Every hit has its real latitude and longitude. In the game, open the menu: the bottom line shows where you are (lat, lon, x, z, street, area) with a Copy button; to go to a hit, use the x and z in the address `?play&city=delhi&at=<landmark id>` and drive, or paste the coordinates here.

| class | hits | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| park_building | 30 | a large building mostly on a park (a station, landmark outline or mis-tagged polygon drawn as a block over open ground) |
| street_building | 119 | a ground street running through a mapped building for 15 m or more (data) |
| void_block | 4684 | a built-up block of 15,000 m2 and up with under 5 % built (a flat grey void) |
| landmark_offset | 3 | a landmark more than 150 m from the centre of its footprint (label in the wrong place) |
| footway_run | 94 | a footway inside a carriageway for over 16 m (drawn grey; the zebra rule only takes short crossings) |
